seeker.headline: Find your room
seeker.body: The game, the finale, the award show, election night. Find a watch party near you and show up.

host.headline: Host the night
host.body: Pick what's on, say where, and set the guest list. A bar, a rooftop or your living room all work.

sponsor.headline: Back the night
sponsor.body: Sponsor a local watch party and put your name in front of the people in the room. Hosts approve every sponsor.
